defect_hypothesis_tested: Did `D2_V1793_MACRO_PLUS_UNICORN_MTF_FULL` produce 0 trades in V17.9.3 because of an engineering defect in `bind_unicorn_to_causal_episode` or because of genuine HTF conflicts?
root_cause_finding: BOTH an engineering defect AND genuine HTF structure conflicts were present: (1) Defect fixed: `bind_unicorn_to_causal_episode` in `backend/services/v17_9_3_macro_unicorn_intelligence.py` previously accessed `getattr(mtf_context, 'timeframe_states', None)` instead of `mtf_context.mtf_structure`, causing `htf_aligned` to fail closed (`UNICORN_HTF_CONTEXT_MISSING_FAIL_CLOSED`) whenever `require_mtf_alignment=True` (`D2`). Furthermore, `D2` requires `ablation_mode='STRUCTURE_ONLY'` on the MTF gate so liquidity target proximity is enforced by V17.9.2 TP rather than double-blocking entry. (2) After fixing the attribute resolution, checkpoint `10434` (`SMC_M1_FVG_CONTINUATION`, `SHORT`) passes `D2` (`D2_ELIGIBLE_AFTER_MTF_BINDING_FIX`), whereas checkpoints `4680`, `5052`, `5238`, and `19624` have genuine H4/H1 opposing structure (`TRUE_H4_H1_STRUCTURE_CONFLICT` / `TRUE_H1_STRUCTURE_CONFLICT`) and remain legitimately rejected by `D2`.
